snippet_preview_surface_label: Example State official voter-information snippet and preview policy
delivery_role_note: Snippet ceilings, targeted excerpt suppression, image-preview settings, and AI-excerpt boundaries shape how official voter-information pages are previewed before the current official page/help lane is opened.
page_level_preview_policy_note: The office assigns page classes to explicit preview states such as ordinary preview, bounded max-snippet ceilings, or nosnippet when open-ended excerpting would mislead or over-compress the current rule.
element_level_excerpt_boundary_note: Targeted data-nosnippet markup is used for volatile or decontextualizable text regions rather than assuming a sitewide setting can safely cover every page fragment.
structured_data_overlap_note: When a page carries structured data that may restate the answer, the office reviews that machine-readable content separately instead of assuming text-level snippet suppression will also suppress the structured-data answer shell.
ai_feature_boundary_note: Snippet-eligibility choices are treated as part of the office's posture toward AI-feature supporting links and direct-input reuse.
image_preview_policy_note: Large-image previews are allowed only for representative current imagery; generic seals, stale election-cycle artwork, or misleading hero banners are not relied on as first-contact cues.
meta_description_policy_note: Critical pages retain page-specific meta descriptions, but the office does not treat them as guaranteed displayed text or as a substitute for explicit preview ceilings.
